n7e82c2307a.headline: J&K Economy Grows, But the Exchequer Leans Harder on Delhi: CAG Audit Flags Deepening Fiscal Dependence
n7e82c2307a.summary: A CAG audit of Jammu and Kashmir reports GSDP growth of 11.18% in 2024-25. Central grants-in-aid now make up nearly 72% of revenue receipts, while own tax revenue grew just 2.5%.
n7e82c2307a.why: The Comptroller and Auditor General of India audits public finances of central and state governments. Heavy reliance on central transfers affects how fiscally self-sufficient a region is.

ncd016c1d9d.headline: Diesel tops 190p a litre but US-Iran ceasefire raises hopes of price stability
ncd016c1d9d.summary: The RAC says the average diesel price was 190.6p on Wednesday, up 33.9p since February 28, as a US-Iran ceasefire raises hopes of price stability.
ncd016c1d9d.why: Diesel is a major input for road transport and logistics, so its price feeds into freight costs and UK inflation.

ne73fb5435d.headline: Trump says US will help with traffic buildup in Strait of Hormuz
ne73fb5435d.summary: US President Donald Trump said the United States will help with the buildup of shipping traffic in the Strait of Hormuz. He had agreed to a two-week ceasefire with Iran shortly before his deadline.
ne73fb5435d.why: Shipping flows through Hormuz carry a large share of global seaborne oil, so changes in transit conditions affect energy markets and freight costs.

source.name: WSAU News/Talk 550 AM · 99.9 FM | Wausau, Stevens Point

sources.name: WSAU News/Talk 550 AM · 99.9 FM | Wausau, Stevens Point

ne73fb5435d.why_moved: A pledged US role in clearing shipping traffic through Hormuz, alongside a two-week ceasefire, bears on the supply outlook for oil.

nadcb50ad14.headline: Cabinet approves Rs 41,534 cr P&K fertilisers subsidy for kharif 2026 season
nadcb50ad14.summary: India's cabinet approved a Rs 41,534 crore subsidy for phosphatic and potassic fertilisers for the kharif season. The outlay is about 12% higher than last year.
nadcb50ad14.why: Fertiliser subsidies lower farm input costs and influence crop output, government fiscal spending and the agriculture sector.

n988c15b9aa.headline: Diesel prices hit 4-year high in Czech Republic
n988c15b9aa.summary: The price of diesel fuel in the Czech Republic has reached its highest level in the past four years, according to AzerNEWS. No further details on drivers were given.
n988c15b9aa.why: Diesel prices feed into transport and logistics costs, which pass through to inflation and corporate margins.

n60326dbf7a.headline: A fragile U.S.-Iran ceasefire shows cracks as attacks continue across the region
n60326dbf7a.summary: Iran, the US and Israel said they would suspend strikes, but countries in the region continued to report attacks. Israel said it would not stop its assault in Lebanon.
n60326dbf7a.why: Conflict in the Middle East affects oil supply routes and prices, shipping risk and global risk appetite.
n60326dbf7a.why_moved: Reports of continued attacks despite the announced suspension of strikes keep supply and security risks in the Middle East elevated.

nd0f85c1106.headline: Rachel Reeves hammers motorists with new £560 charge for petrol drivers
nd0f85c1106.summary: Vehicle tax is set to rise this month for motorists, according to the Daily Star, after fuel prices soared due to the Middle East war. The report describes it as a new charge for petrol drivers.
nd0f85c1106.why: Vehicle excise duty is a UK government levy on car owners, and fuel and tax policy shape consumer spending and inflation.

n5755da41e8.headline: Bitcoin and ethereum price today, Wednesday, April 8, 2026: Prices rise after U.S.-Iran ceasefire announcement
n5755da41e8.summary: Bitcoin opened higher at $71,926.16 and ether at $2,239.89 following President Trump's announcement of a temporary ceasefire agreement with Iran.
n5755da41e8.why: Bitcoin is the largest cryptocurrency by market value and trades around the clock. Its price often reacts to shifts in global risk sentiment.
n5755da41e8.why_moved: The report links the rise to President Trump's announcement of a temporary ceasefire agreement with Iran, which improved risk sentiment.

n72e377a04d.headline: Rand and JSE firm as markets cheer Middle East ceasefire
n72e377a04d.summary: The rand and the JSE firmed as markets welcomed the Middle East ceasefire. The oil price and the dollar fell on hopes that oil will flow through the Strait of Hormuz.
n72e377a04d.why: The rand is South Africa's currency, and the JSE is the country's main stock exchange. Both are sensitive to oil prices and global risk appetite.
n72e377a04d.why_moved: The ceasefire lifted risk sentiment, while lower oil prices and a weaker dollar on hopes of Hormuz flows supported the rand and equities.

nd5940e1784.headline: Ceasefire is threatened as Israel expands Lebanon strikes and Iran closes strait again
nd5940e1784.summary: A ceasefire to pause the war in Iran appears to be hanging by a thread after Iran closed the Strait of Hormuz again in response to Israeli attacks in Lebanon. Israel has expanded its strikes in Lebanon.
nd5940e1784.why: The Strait of Hormuz is a key transit route for a large share of global seaborne oil, so disruptions there quickly affect crude prices and shipping costs.
nd5940e1784.why_moved: Iran's renewed closure of the Strait of Hormuz, in response to Israeli strikes in Lebanon, puts an existing ceasefire at risk. Threats to Gulf shipping routes typically raise oil prices and risk premia.

n0353535946.headline: MoHUA notifies new TOD policy, charges
n0353535946.summary: India's Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs has notified a new Transit Oriented Development policy and charges for 2026 for Delhi. The policy governs development around transit corridors.
n0353535946.why: Transit-oriented development rules shape land use, real estate development and infrastructure funding around metro and transit hubs.

n1316ec702b.headline: US, Israel and Iran agree to two-week ceasefire though some attacks continue
n1316ec702b.summary: The US, Israel and Iran have agreed a two-week ceasefire, though some attacks continue. It was unclear whether the strikes would scuttle the deal, which US Vice President JD Vance called fragile.
n1316ec702b.why: Middle East hostilities affect oil supply expectations, shipping routes and risk appetite across global markets. Investors watch ceasefire durability closely for energy and safe-haven flows.
n1316ec702b.why_moved: The ceasefire agreement, and uncertainty over whether continuing attacks will undermine it, bear on regional conflict risk and energy-market expectations.

n5c2db756f4.headline: Australia’s biggest telcos are raising prices again
n5c2db756f4.summary: Australia's biggest telcos, Telstra, Optus and Vodafone, are raising prices again. The three carriers are moving in step on pricing.
n5c2db756f4.why: Telstra is Australia's largest telecommunications provider, and pricing changes affect subscriber revenue and inflation in household services. Coordinated price rises are closely watched by regulators and investors.

impacts.name: Telstra
impacts.why: Higher consumer prices can lift telco revenue per customer.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

n166e58bfbd.headline: Market Cheers Ceasefire In Biggest Rally This Year So Far, Sensex Jumps Nearly 2,950 Points
n166e58bfbd.summary: Indian stocks rallied for a fifth straight session on April 8, with the Sensex rising 2,946 points and the Nifty gaining 3.78%. The RBI held its repo rate at 5.25%.
n166e58bfbd.why: The Sensex is the benchmark index of the Bombay Stock Exchange, tracking 30 large Indian companies. Its moves reflect shifts in domestic and foreign investor sentiment toward India.
n166e58bfbd.why_moved: Easing global tensions following a ceasefire and a steady RBI repo rate at 5.25% boosted sentiment. Analysts flagged a breakout above 24,500 on the Nifty as key for further gains.

nbde017c3a7.headline: India says it has enough coal stocks to meet power demand
nbde017c3a7.summary: India has ample coal reserves, with stocks at mines and power plants sufficient for 24 days of power generation. Total national coal stock stands at 220 million tons.
nbde017c3a7.why: Coal is a major fuel for India's power sector, and stock levels determine how reliably the grid can operate during supply disruptions.

n4299515401.headline: Un tuk-tuk, caratteristico taxi a tre ruote nelle strade thailandesi - Curiosita - Ansa.it
n4299515401.summary: Thailand's Commerce Ministry raised its 2026 headline inflation forecast to between 1.5% and 2%.
n4299515401.why: Inflation forecasts guide Thai monetary policy and interest rate expectations, which affect bond yields and the baht.

nc990f291e3.headline: Un banco dove si serve anatra stufata nel mercato alimentare di Bangkok - Curiosita - Ansa.it
nc990f291e3.summary: Thailand's Commerce Ministry raised its 2026 headline inflation forecast. Food prices at Bangkok markets are rising.
nc990f291e3.why: Inflation forecasts guide Thailand's central bank and government policy, affecting interest rates, the baht and consumer spending.

n1ad578d465.headline: Oil prices plunge and stocks soar after US and Iran agree on a ceasefire
n1ad578d465.summary: Oil prices fell sharply and stocks rose after the US and Iran agreed a ceasefire. Investors welcomed the prospect of peace and an easing of the global energy crisis.
n1ad578d465.why: Oil is a key input cost for the global economy, so changes in Middle East supply risk move energy prices and broad equity indexes.
n1ad578d465.why_moved: Agreement on a US-Iran ceasefire eased fears of supply disruption, pulling oil prices lower and lifting stocks on relief about the energy crisis.

n0f2be3f35a.headline: Stocks Close The Day Higher As Oil Prices Plummet Over Iran War Cease Fire
n0f2be3f35a.summary: US stocks closed higher as oil prices plummeted over a ceasefire in the Iran war. The report gives no further detail on index levels.
n0f2be3f35a.why: Oil prices feed into inflation, corporate costs and energy-sector earnings, so swings in crude often drive broad equity moves.
n0f2be3f35a.why_moved: Oil prices fell sharply after a ceasefire in the Iran war was reported, easing supply-disruption fears that had lifted energy prices.

n5c50d27260.headline: Oil prices plunge 15%, stock futures surge after Trump announces Iran war ceasefire
n5c50d27260.summary: U.S. crude fell to about $95 per barrel after trading as high as $117 on Tuesday. Stock futures surged following the ceasefire announcement.
n5c50d27260.why: Crude oil prices feed through to fuel costs, inflation and energy company earnings across the global economy. Iran's position in the Gulf makes its conflicts a key driver of oil supply risk.
n5c50d27260.why_moved: Trump's announcement of a ceasefire in the Iran war reduced fears of supply disruption, and crude prices fell from a recent high of $117.

ndb227b1797.headline: Iran closes Hormuz Strait in response to Israeli attacks on Lebanon
ndb227b1797.summary: Iran closed the Strait of Hormuz in response to Israeli attacks on Lebanon. The report says Iran, the US and Israel had agreed to a two-week ceasefire on Tuesday.
ndb227b1797.why: The Strait of Hormuz is a critical chokepoint for global oil and LNG shipments, so closures quickly affect energy prices and shipping costs.
ndb227b1797.why_moved: Iran's closure of the Strait of Hormuz threatens Gulf oil and LNG flows, raising supply concerns.

na02b18b43f.headline: Warm US Temps and Sinking Crude Prices Weigh on Nat-Gas Prices
na02b18b43f.summary: May Nymex natural gas closed down 5.09% and hit a 7.5-month nearest-futures low. Above-normal US temperature forecasts reduce heating demand, and sinking crude prices also weighed.
na02b18b43f.why: Natural gas is a key fuel for US power generation and heating, so weather-driven demand changes move gas futures sharply.
na02b18b43f.why_moved: Above-normal US temperature forecasts reduce heating demand, and sinking crude prices also weighed on the market.

n8051937b40.headline: Rwanda's Central Bank Warns Bybit Over Illegal FRW Crypto Trading
n8051937b40.summary: The Central Bank of Rwanda warned Bybit about its FRW crypto peer-to-peer launch, saying franc-linked digital asset trades are not protected by law.
n8051937b40.why: Bybit is a large global crypto exchange, and national regulators' warnings can restrict its services and signal compliance risk in emerging markets.

nb52eba35cb.headline: Super Micro Board Probes Export Allegations As Valuation Signals Potential Upside
nb52eba35cb.summary: Super Micro Computer has launched an independent investigation into alleged illegal exports of AI hardware to China, linked to three individuals. The company is not named as a defendant in the March 2026 indictment.
nb52eba35cb.why: Super Micro is a US maker of servers used in AI data centers, so export compliance and legal risks affect its revenue and reputation. Export controls on AI chips and hardware to China are a major policy focus.

n1d814579a3.headline: PSX posts highest-ever single-day gain of over 14,000 points
n1d814579a3.summary: The Pakistan Stock Exchange surged by more than 14,000 points on Wednesday, its highest-ever single-day gain. The rally followed a development in Pakistan that the report did not detail.
n1d814579a3.why: The Pakistan Stock Exchange is the main equity market in Pakistan, and index moves reflect investor sentiment about the country's economy. Sharp swings are common in frontier markets.
n1d814579a3.why_moved: The exchange surged more than 14,000 points on Wednesday after a development in Pakistan, according to the report, which did not specify the trigger in full.

n1b879079d4.headline: Thailand Cuts Diesel Prices By 2.14-Baht-Per-Litre Affective Immediately
n1b879079d4.summary: Thailand has cut diesel prices by 2.14 baht per litre with immediate effect, giving motorists and transport operators relief at the pump.
n1b879079d4.why: Diesel prices affect transport and logistics costs throughout Thailand's economy. Government-linked fuel price adjustments influence inflation and consumer spending.

n1c644a1722.headline: Iran maintains vigilance on ceasefire with United States
n1c644a1722.summary: Iran said it maintains vigilance on the ceasefire with the United States and would respond with full force to any error by the enemy.
n1c644a1722.why: A US-Iran ceasefire affects Middle East security and oil supply risk, which in turn influences energy markets and regional stability. Investors watch these talks for signals on escalation.

n0d070f502a.headline: Oil plunges below $95 as the Dow surges 1,300 in a worldwide rally following a ceasefire with Iran
n0d070f502a.summary: Oil prices fell below $95 a barrel and stock markets rallied worldwide after President Donald Trump pulled back from threatened attacks on Iran. The Dow surged 1,300 points.
n0d070f502a.why: Brent and WTI are the benchmark crude oil prices, and US equity indexes like the Dow reflect broad sentiment about growth and risk.
n0d070f502a.why_moved: Trump pulled back from threatened attacks on Iran after a ceasefire, easing fears of Gulf supply disruption and lifting risk appetite worldwide.

na8540226d1.headline: US–Iran Ceasefire Brings Temporary Relief Amid Escalating Middle East Conflict
na8540226d1.summary: A temporary US-Iran ceasefire has eased tensions after intense military strikes, according to reports. The truce's durability was not specified in the input.
na8540226d1.why: Hostilities involving Iran affect Gulf oil flows and shipping routes, which feed directly into energy prices and global market sentiment.

source.name: Pragativadi I Latest Odisha News in English I Breaking News

sources.name: Pragativadi I Latest Odisha News in English I Breaking News

na8540226d1.why_moved: A temporary ceasefire reduced the risk of further strikes affecting Gulf energy and shipping, supporting risk assets.

n7927574364.headline: Ordinary Filipinos endure heat, lengthy wait for cheaper rice
n7927574364.summary: Ordinary Filipinos are enduring heat and long waits to buy cheaper rice. Vendors are limiting sales despite having stock, according to Bulatlat.
n7927574364.why: Rice is a staple food in the Philippines, and its price and supply affect household inflation and government food policy.

n69502cd5ff.headline: Why surging ASX 200 copper stocks like Sandfire and BHP shares are ‘vulnerable’
n69502cd5ff.summary: Copper stocks on the S&P/ASX 200 index, including BHP and Sandfire, surged on Monday. The report questions whether the outperformance can be sustained.
n69502cd5ff.why: BHP is one of the world's largest miners and Sandfire is a copper producer, so both are sensitive to copper prices and Chinese demand.

n25ec84eefb.headline: Exxon Mobil Signals $2.9B Q1 Earnings Bump On Higher Oil Prices
n25ec84eefb.summary: Exxon Mobil said surging oil and gas prices triggered by the conflict with Iran could lift its first-quarter upstream earnings by up to $2.9 billion. The company is a major US oil and gas producer.
n25ec84eefb.why: Exxon Mobil is one of the largest publicly traded integrated oil companies, so its earnings reflect crude and gas price moves. Its results are closely watched as a gauge of the energy sector.

impacts.name: Exxon Mobil
impacts.why: Higher oil and gas prices raise upstream revenue and profit for producers.

ne3c14f8b2e.headline: Oil Slumps, Stock Markets Surge As First Ships Transit Hormuz
ne3c14f8b2e.summary: Oil equities slumped amid falling oil prices on Wednesday morning while broader equity markets posted major gains. The report links the moves to the first ships transiting the Strait of Hormuz.
ne3c14f8b2e.why: The Strait of Hormuz is a key chokepoint for seaborne crude and LNG exports from the Gulf, so shipping disruptions there feed directly into global oil prices.
ne3c14f8b2e.why_moved: Oil prices fell and equity markets rallied after the first ships began transiting the Strait of Hormuz, reducing perceived supply risk in the Gulf.

ne08367371e.headline: Pakistan’s Hormuz moment: mediator gains, but strategic test lies ahead
ne08367371e.summary: Pakistan has emerged as a key mediator between the United States and Iran, a significant diplomatic shift. The long-term impact will depend on how the unfolding truce develops.
ne08367371e.why: Gulf diplomacy shapes the security of Hormuz shipping and regional energy flows that matter to global oil and LNG markets.

nae960ad5cf.headline: Omoda C5 hybrid launched in SA with claimed 1,000km range
nae960ad5cf.summary: Omoda introduced the C5 SHS, its first non-plug-in hybrid model, offering a claimed range of 1,000 kilometers in South Africa.
nae960ad5cf.why: New hybrid vehicle launches reflect automotive industry trends toward electrification and can influence market competition and consumer adoption.

n48aaabf5ca.headline: CBN to launch new FX manual to boost inflows
n48aaabf5ca.summary: The Central Bank of Nigeria will soon launch a new foreign exchange manual aimed at attracting inflows and strengthening currency market stability.
n48aaabf5ca.why: Nigeria's FX market is critical for economic stability and investment; new regulatory measures can influence currency stability and foreign investment flows.
